risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and well quantified, with clear segment performance, customer concentration, contract terms, and operating drivers. Key risks include substantial dependence on FedEx, cancellable one-year contracts, discretionary USAF purchasing, and declining consolidated revenue, although operating performance improved in two segments. Boilerplate forward-looking and accounting language modestly reduces transparency but does not dominate the excerpt.
